title: Claymation (templateless)
theme_prompt: CLAYMATION / stop-motion plasticine media player: hand-sculpted modelling clay with visible FINGERPRINTS, thumb-press dents, tool marks and slightly wobbly hand-made edges — like an Aardman / Wallace-and-Gromit prop. Soft matte plasticine, NOT plastic, NOT glossy, NOT digital-smooth. Use ONLY 3-4 DISTINCT clay colours total, each with clear separation in both hue AND value so forms read instantly: one saturated TERRACOTTA/BURNT-ORANGE for the main body, one CREAM/BONE for a subset of buttons, one MOSS GREEN for the rest of the buttons, one near-black UMBER for recessed wells and dark glass. EVERY part is sculpted from ONE consistent, undiluted colour of clay — NO gradient blending, NO marbling, NO two-tone streaking or kneaded-together colour transitions within a single part. Colour changes happen ONLY at a clean physical seam between two separate pieces of clay (e.g. the body is one colour, a button pressed into it is a different colour, with a crisp edge between them — not a smeared gradient). Keep the palette tight and confident, not a muddy assortment — fewer, bolder, more legible colours read as more hand-crafted than many blended ones. Rounded squashy forms, slightly irregular buttons like pressed clay pellets, a screen like a smoothed clay slab. Soft studio lighting with gentle clay sheen. Charming, tactile, imperfect — clearly sculpted by hand.

lighting.emissive_hint: none — matte plasticine; only the visualizer screen emits, softly
